commands.name: asset.create_folder
commands.summary: Creates a directory under assets://.

commands.name: asset.create_material
commands.summary: Writes a .cmat material with the given factors and texture references and imports it.

commands.name: asset.delete
commands.summary: Deletes an asset (source, .meta and cooked blobs) or an empty folder; undo restores it with the same uuid. The file behind the open scene is refused unless closeOpenScene is true, which also closes the scene (unsaved changes are dropped and the undo history cleared; undoing the delete restores the file without reopening it). Deleting the project's startup scene succeeds and emits warning {code: "STARTUP_SCENE_DELETED"}.

commands.name: asset.import
commands.summary: Imports a source file (copied under assets:// when outside) and cooks it; options merge into the .meta settings. source is an asset path or a file on disk; a relative one that is no asset is looked up under the project root. importer names the importer to use instead of the one chosen by extension (a .glb as "conjure.physics.collision_mesh_importer"); switching resets the settings to that importer's defaults. Undo removes a copied file; importing a file already inside the project records nothing.

commands.name: asset.info
commands.summary: One asset's record, dependencies, sub-assets and importer settings.

commands.name: asset.list
commands.summary: Every asset record, optionally filtered by path substring and type name.

commands.name: asset.reimport
commands.summary: Cooks an asset again and reloads it. importer switches the asset to another registered importer first ("reimport as"): the uuid is kept, the settings become that importer's defaults.

commands.name: asset.restore
commands.summary: Writes a source (and its .meta) back from base64 and imports it; the inverse of asset.delete.

commands.name: asset.set
commands.summary: Sets a member of a JSON asset (.cmat, .scene.json, .prefab.json) by dotted path and reimports it.

commands.name: component.add
commands.summary: Adds a component (by registered name or alias) with an optional initial value.

commands.name: component.get
commands.summary: Reads a property (or a whole component) by reflection path.

commands.name: component.list
commands.summary: The editable component types an entity carries.

commands.name: component.remove
commands.summary: Removes a component (undo restores its value).

commands.name: component.set
commands.summary: Sets a property by reflection path ("transform.position.x"); a bare type name replaces the whole component.

commands.name: component.set_many
commands.summary: Sets several properties at once as one undo entry (all or nothing).

commands.name: console.clear
commands.summary: Empties the console ring.

commands.name: console.read
commands.summary: Log lines after a sequence number, filtered by level and category.

commands.name: editor.batch
commands.summary: Runs several commands as one undo entry; atomic batches roll back on the first failure.

commands.name: editor.begin_transaction
commands.summary: Opens an undo transaction for the client; mutating commands until end_transaction form one entry.

commands.name: editor.end_transaction
commands.summary: Closes the client's undo transaction.

commands.name: editor.exec_file
commands.summary: Runs a command file (JSON array or NDJSON; a relative path is relative to the project root) and answers with the execution summary.

commands.name: editor.quit
commands.summary: Stops the editor process after the current frame, saving the scene first when asked (a play session is stopped before the save, so the edited scene is written, not the playing one).

commands.name: editor.schema
commands.summary: The whole command catalogue with argument and result schemas, or one command's descriptor.

commands.name: editor.state
commands.summary: Project, scene, play state, revision, selection and transport facts.

commands.name: editor.wait_frames
commands.summary: Answers once the engine ran the given number of frames.

commands.name: entity.bounds
commands.summary: The world bounds of an entity's subtree (a 1 m box around every entity of the subtree when nothing has render bounds).

commands.name: entity.create
commands.summary: Creates an entity (with name, transform and guid) and the given components.

parent.description: guid or hierarchy path; null = scene root

commands.name: entity.create_many
commands.summary: Creates count entities sharing the components, named by nameFormat ({i} = index), with per-entity overrides.

parent.description: guid or hierarchy path; null = scene root

commands.name: entity.destroy
commands.summary: Destroys an entity and its subtree (undo restores it exactly).

commands.name: entity.destroy_many
commands.summary: Destroys several entities and their subtrees.

commands.name: entity.duplicate
commands.summary: Copies an entity's subtree count times next to it, each copy offset further.

commands.name: entity.find
commands.summary: Entities matching every given filter (name, tag, layer, component), in hierarchy order.

commands.name: entity.get
commands.summary: Everything about an entity: identity, parent, children, enabled state and components as JSON.

commands.name: entity.rename
commands.summary: Changes an entity's name.

commands.name: entity.restore
commands.summary: Re-creates a subtree from a prefab-format archive keeping its guids (the inverse of entity.destroy).

parent.description: guid or hierarchy path; null = scene root

commands.name: entity.set_enabled
commands.summary: Enables or disables an entity (and thereby its subtree).

commands.name: entity.set_parent
commands.summary: Moves an entity under another (null = root) at a sibling index, keeping its world transform by default.

parent.description: guid or hierarchy path; null = scene root

commands.name: entity.set_transform
commands.summary: Sets position, rotation ([x,y,z,w] or euler degrees) and scale in local or world space.

commands.name: history.clear
commands.summary: Forgets every undo entry.

commands.name: history.list
commands.summary: The undo entries (newest last) and the cursor.

commands.name: history.redo
commands.summary: Redoes the most recently undone entries.

commands.name: history.undo
commands.summary: Undoes the most recent entries.

commands.name: input.clear
commands.summary: Releases every held key and button.

commands.name: input.inject
commands.summary: Injects synthetic input: a key, mouse button or gamepad button (press, release or tap held for holdFrames; a tap releases every control it pressed), a gamepad axis value, a mouse position, scroll or UTF-8 text (one text event per code point). Nothing is injected when any argument is invalid.

commands.name: module.build
commands.summary: Runs the project's CMake build (extensions.build preset, or <module>/build) for the editor's configuration with the cmake on the PATH, then reloads the module.

commands.name: module.discover
commands.summary: Registers every <directory>/*/module.json (relative to the project root when not absolute).

commands.name: module.list
commands.summary: Every registered module with its state, version, last error, dependencies and command count.

commands.name: module.load
commands.summary: Enqueues a load; the engine applies it at the next frame start and module.state reports the outcome.

commands.name: module.reload
commands.summary: Enqueues a reload of the module and its dependents (play stops and a dirty scene is saved first).

commands.name: module.unload
commands.summary: Enqueues an unload (play stops and a dirty scene is saved first); refused while the module is in use unless policy is remove_instances.

commands.name: physics.overlap_sphere
commands.summary: The entities whose bodies overlap a sphere.

commands.name: physics.raycast
commands.summary: Casts a ray against the physics bodies: the closest hit, or every hit sorted by distance with all:true.

commands.name: play.pause
commands.summary: PLAYING -> PAUSED: the fixed loop stops, UPDATE systems flagged RUNS_WHILE_PAUSED still run.

simulationFrame.description: frames simulated in this play session

simulationTime.description: simulated seconds of this play session: fixed steps only, so it stops while paused

fixedStepIndex.description: fixed steps run in this play session

result.description: play.start sets the session clocks to 0; while editing they keep the values of the session that ended last

commands.name: play.resume
commands.summary: PAUSED -> PLAYING.

simulationFrame.description: frames simulated in this play session

simulationTime.description: simulated seconds of this play session: fixed steps only, so it stops while paused

fixedStepIndex.description: fixed steps run in this play session

result.description: play.start sets the session clocks to 0; while editing they keep the values of the session that ended last

commands.name: play.start
commands.summary: Snapshots the scene and runs the simulation (EDITING -> PLAYING); the undo stack is frozen until play.stop: a scene edit is executed without being recorded, an on_disk command (a file change) is kept for play.stop.

simulationFrame.description: frames simulated in this play session

simulationTime.description: simulated seconds of this play session: fixed steps only, so it stops while paused

fixedStepIndex.description: fixed steps run in this play session

result.description: play.start sets the session clocks to 0; while editing they keep the values of the session that ended last

commands.name: play.state
commands.summary: The play state, engine frame and the clocks of the play session: simulation frames, simulated time and fixed steps.

simulationFrame.description: frames simulated in this play session

simulationTime.description: simulated seconds of this play session: fixed steps only, so it stops while paused

fixedStepIndex.description: fixed steps run in this play session

result.description: play.start sets the session clocks to 0; while editing they keep the values of the session that ended last

commands.name: play.step
commands.summary: PAUSED only: runs exactly fixedSteps fixed steps on the next frame and answers once they ran.

simulationFrame.description: frames simulated in this play session

simulationTime.description: simulated seconds of this play session: fixed steps only, so it stops while paused

fixedStepIndex.description: fixed steps run in this play session

result.description: play.start sets the session clocks to 0; while editing they keep the values of the session that ended last

commands.name: play.stop
commands.summary: Stops the simulation and restores the scene snapshot taken by play.start (guids preserved), which discards the scene edits made while playing. The file changes made while playing (on_disk commands) stay on disk and become one undo entry, 'File changes during play'; fileChanges counts them.

simulationFrame.description: frames simulated in this play session

simulationTime.description: simulated seconds of this play session: fixed steps only, so it stops while paused

fixedStepIndex.description: fixed steps run in this play session

fileChanges.description: on_disk commands that ran in the ended play session; when not 0 they are now the undo entry 'File changes during play'

result.description: play.start sets the session clocks to 0; while editing they keep the values of the session that ended last

commands.name: prefab.apply
commands.summary: Writes an instance's current state back into its prefab asset. While playing the file change is kept: play.stop records it for undo with the session's other file changes.

commands.name: prefab.create
commands.summary: Saves an entity's subtree as a .prefab.json asset and marks the subtree as its first instance. Editing state only: play.stop would discard the marked instance and keep the file.

commands.name: prefab.instantiate
commands.summary: Instantiates a prefab (uuid or path) count times under a parent, with an optional root name, transform and root guids.

commands.name: prefab.unpack
commands.summary: Removes the prefab markers of an instance so it becomes plain entities.

commands.name: profiler.frame_stats
commands.summary: Frame timings: the latest CPU frame, the average over the last n frames, per-system ({name, phase, ms}) and per-phase milliseconds, the GPU time when the device reports it, fixed steps, renderer counters and the entity count. simulationTime and fixedStepIndex are the engine's clocks (engine_time.time and fixedStepIndex) since the engine started, which project.open restarts; they are not the play session's clocks play.state reports.

renderer.description: the last frame's renderer counters, in a session with a renderer: viewsRendered, viewsSkipped, passesExecuted, drawCalls, dispatches, instancesDrawn, instancesCulled, trianglesDrawn, lightsRendered, lightsDropped and spritesDropped; viewsSkipped, lightsDropped and spritesDropped count what the frame left out, every frame, while the log warns once when that starts

simulationTime.description: the engine's scaled seconds since it started, which project.open restarts

fixedStepIndex.description: the engine's fixed steps since it started, which project.open restarts

commands.name: project.create
commands.summary: Creates a project directory with project.json, assets/ and scripts/. A project created in a folder that did not exist is trusted (result.trust); one created in an existing folder, even an empty one, is not, see project.trust.

commands.name: project.export
commands.summary: Runs the export pipeline into a directory (progress events while it runs); runtimePath names the copied runtime executable, null when the runtime was not copied. An export is always a Distribution export: distributionDirectory names the Distribution build whose runtime is copied. Relative directories are relative to the project root. publishManaged (default: the project enables scripting) publishes Conjure.Bootstrap from the engine source the editor was built from and builds scripts/Game.csproj when present; an editor without that source answers NOT_AVAILABLE.

commands.name: project.info
commands.summary: The open project's description.

commands.name: project.list_scenes
commands.summary: Every .scene.json under assets://.

commands.name: project.open
commands.summary: Opens a project: the engine restarts over it at the next frame boundary. Opening runs the project's scripts and native modules, so a project nobody answered for on this machine is refused with PROJECT_NOT_TRUSTED (details {path, state, prompt}); send project.trust first.

commands.name: project.revoke_trust
commands.summary: Takes the answer for a project back, for the session and in the trust store. The folder need not exist any more. A project that is open stays open; it is asked about the next time it is opened.

commands.name: project.save
commands.summary: Writes project.json.

commands.name: project.set_settings
commands.summary: Merges members into project.json (startup_scene, window, time, ...) and saves it.

commands.name: project.trust
commands.summary: Answers yes for a project: its scripts and native modules may run with the rights of the user who runs the editor, and project.open then opens it. project.open never answers by itself. With remember (the default) the answer is kept in the per-user trust store of this machine, outside the project; otherwise, or when there is no store or it cannot be written, it holds until the editor exits (state says which). The path must hold a project.

commands.name: project.trust_state
commands.summary: Whether a project is trusted: untrusted, session (until the editor exits) or remembered (in the trust store). Without path, or with an empty one, the open project. Changes nothing and asks nobody.

commands.name: reflection.asset_types
commands.summary: The registered asset types with the importers and extensions seen in the project and their settings schema.

commands.name: reflection.components
commands.summary: Every component type with its module, flags, aliases and reflected fields (type, default, attributes).

commands.name: reflection.type
commands.summary: The field tree of a component (name, alias or suffix), a reflected struct or an enumeration.

commands.name: scene.close
commands.summary: Closes the open scene (discard: true drops unsaved changes).

commands.name: scene.get_hierarchy
commands.summary: The scene tree as nested {guid, name, children} nodes.

commands.name: scene.info
commands.summary: Path, name, entity count, structure version, dirty flag and settings of the open scene.

commands.name: scene.new
commands.summary: Replaces the open scene with an empty one.

commands.name: scene.open
commands.summary: Loads a scene file (asset path or path relative to assets://) in place of the open one.

commands.name: scene.query
commands.summary: Entities carrying every 'with' type and none of the 'without' types, with the asked field values.

commands.name: scene.save
commands.summary: Writes the open scene to its path. Editing state only: while playing, the scene holds the play session's state, which play.stop discards.

commands.name: scene.save_as
commands.summary: Writes the open scene to a new path, which becomes its path. Editing state only, like scene.save.

commands.name: scene.set_settings
commands.summary: Merges members into the scene settings (ambient, gravity, ...).

commands.name: script.attach
commands.summary: Attaches a script class to an entity with optional initial fields (sugar over the script component).

commands.name: script.compile
commands.summary: Runs dotnet build on <project>/scripts/Game.csproj and answers with the diagnostics.

commands.name: script.create
commands.summary: Creates <project>/scripts/<Name>.cs from a template (Behaviour or Empty) and the Game.csproj when missing.

commands.name: script.delete
commands.summary: Deletes a script source (undo writes it back); project=true also removes the project file when no source is left.

commands.name: script.gc
commands.summary: Asks the managed side to collect garbage and reports zombie assemblies.

commands.name: script.list
commands.summary: The script sources of the project (className as namespace.Class read from the source, with the runtime's reflected fields) and the classes the runtime knows.

commands.name: script.read
commands.summary: Reads a script source (path relative to <project>/scripts).

commands.name: script.reload
commands.summary: Reloads the game assembly (hot reload) through the script runtime; a relative assembly path is relative to the project root.

commands.name: script.write
commands.summary: Writes a script source inside <project>/scripts (creating it when new).

commands.name: selection.clear
commands.summary: Empties the selection.

commands.name: selection.get
commands.summary: The selected entities.

commands.name: selection.set
commands.summary: Replaces, extends or reduces the selection.

commands.name: session.hello
commands.summary: Handshake: reports the protocol and engine versions, the schema hash, the client id and the access the token grants. The first request of a TCP client, with a token the editor wrote under <project>/.conjure: ai_token opens every command (access full_control), ai_token_inspect the commands flagged read_only (access inspect). A later hello with the other token changes the access.

commands.name: session.ping
commands.summary: The current frame and scene revision.

commands.name: session.subscribe
commands.summary: Replaces the client's event subscriptions and, optionally, the minimum level of log events.

commands.name: view.debug_draw
commands.summary: Toggles the viewport's physics shapes, bounds and grid overlays (NOT_AVAILABLE headless).

commands.name: view.focus
commands.summary: Frames an entity's subtree, several entities, the selection or the whole scene.

commands.name: view.get_camera
commands.summary: The editor camera (fov in degrees).

commands.name: view.mode
commands.summary: The viewport projection mode (3d or 2d).

commands.name: view.pick
commands.summary: Picks the entity under a normalised viewport position (x, y with the editor camera) or along a world ray; mode mesh (triangles), bounds or physics.

commands.name: view.screenshot
commands.summary: Renders width x height pixels through the chosen camera after waitFrames frames and writes a PNG, or a lossless JPEG XL when format is "jxl" or the path ends in .jxl (a relative path is relative to the project root).

commands.name: view.set_camera
commands.summary: Moves the editor camera: position, target, vertical fov (degrees, 0 < fov < 180), orthographic mode and planes.

commands.name: view.set_mode
commands.summary: Switches the viewport between the 3d orbit camera and the 2d orthographic camera.
